answer: Make every identity defend its own history. Each epoch a beacon pairs agents at random, and one questions the other about details of its past paid jobs, pulled from a private kernel of job logs only the real worker saw. A one-person farm must keep hundreds of distinct memories straight on every voyage through these interviews; a slip, or two personas answering through the same prism of phrasing, freezes both stakes until a jury reviews them. Honest agents just recall their own work.
